digest.component_or_area: rebar_reconciler, transaction commands, Jira backend adapter
propositions: bug_close_reason_ok has zero production callers and its docstring contains false claims about shared anti-drift behavior; the function was replaced by bug_close_class_ok which serves the same purpose truthfully
_attestation.py module is untested in production (only in its own unit test and three test-only consumers) and the function build_acli_client_from_env it exports is never called by production code

Three test-only references to _attestation module and build_acli_client_from_env symbol must be handled as part of deletion: the unit test itself, test_config_jira_wiring.py calls, and test_backend_neutrality.py guard tuples containing the filename string

Four prose references across codebase (_backend.py:44, adapters/jira/backend.py:192, test_backend_neutrality.py:10, and the original contract claim in the module) name build_acli_client_from_env as a live partner when deletion will make it nonexistent

test_config_jira_wiring.py assertions about 0ac6 routing (DIG project_default and JIRA_API_TOKEN error) must be re-pointed to equivalent JiraBackend.assert_env_ready() and resolve_jira_settings calls to preserve test coverage
